compiled_state.title: [plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh]: post-merge --bump auto-commit -> compliance verifier rejects (no .result artifacts in fresh main checkout)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** af9b4e415d665a9876ca53e8fff0ed291279d3bc (origin/main after PR #235 merge)

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior
After merge-to-main.sh successfully merges a worktree PR to main, the trailing `--bump` step (auto-default to patch) should produce a follow-up commit on main with the bumped version that lands on origin/main without hook friction.

#### Actual Behavior
PR #235 merged successfully at af9b4e41. merge-to-main-pr.sh ran bump-version.sh (1.17.0 → 1.17.1) on the post-merge main checkout, but the resulting `git commit` failed at the compliance verifier:

```
Compliance Verifier (30s timeout) ... Failed
ERROR: pre-commit-compliance-verifier: required artifact 'test.result' not found — run commit-step before committing
ERROR: pre-commit-compliance-verifier: required artifact 'format.result' not found — run commit-step before committing
ERROR: pre-commit-compliance-verifier: required artifact 'lint.result' not found — run commit-step before committing
ERROR: pre-commit-compliance-verifier: required artifact 'classifier-dispatch.result' not found — run commit-step before committing
ERROR: pre-commit-compliance-verifier: required artifact 'reviewer-record.result' not found — run commit-step before committing
```

The 5 required compliance artifacts (test/format/lint/classifier-dispatch/reviewer-record .result files) were not pre-emitted by merge-to-main-pr.sh for the auto-bump commit. plugin.json on origin/main remains at 1.17.0; the bump never lands.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (auto-bump phase)
* plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh (pre-commit gate)
* plugins/dso/scripts/commit-step.sh (artifact emitter — needs to be called by the auto-bump phase before its commit)

### 7. Suggested fix direction (not prescribed)
Wrap the auto-bump commit in commit-step.sh calls for the 5 required artifacts (with skip markers since this is a mechanical version-file change, not a code review), or special-case the `--bump` commit in pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh.
